description_en: Queries the detailed information of a Tair (Redis® OSS-Compatible) instance
description_zh: 查询云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的详细信息
name: DescribeInstanceAttribute

ArchitectureType.description_en:
The architecture of the instance. Valid values:
cluster: Cluster Edition.
standard: Standard Edition.
rwsplit: read/write splitting edition
ArchitectureType.description_zh:
实例的架构，返回值：
cluster：集群版。
standard：标准版。
rwsplit：读写分离版

AuditLogRetention.description_en: The log retention period configured in the audit log settings. Unit: days. A value of 0 indicates that the audit log feature is not enabled. For information about how to enable this feature, see [Enable audit logging]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/102015.html）
AuditLogRetention.description_zh: 审计日志中设置的日志保留时间，单位为天。0代表未开通审计日志，开通方式请参见[开通审计日志]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/102015.html）

AutoSecondaryZone.description_en:
Indicates whether the secondary zone is automatically allocated. Valid values:
true: Automatically allocated.
false: Not automatically allocated
AutoSecondaryZone.description_zh:
自动分配 Secondary 可用区。
true：自动分配
false：非自动分配

AvailabilityValue.description_en: The availability metric for the current month

BackupLogStartTime.description_en: The earliest point in time to which data can be restored by using the flashback feature. The time follows the format of yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC). This parameter is returned only when the [data flashback]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/148479.html） feature is enabled for the instance. When you call the [RestoreInstance]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473824.html） operation to perform data flashback, you can use the value of this parameter to determine the earliest point in time to which data can be restored (the earliest value that can be specified for RestoreTime)
BackupLogStartTime.description_zh: 允许闪回的最早时间点，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 当Redis实例开启了[数据闪回]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/148479.html）功能，才会返回本参数。 调用[RestoreInstance]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473824.html）接口执行数据闪回时，可通过本参数的返回值确认允许闪回的最早时间点（即**RestoreTime**可传入的最早时间点）

ChargeType.description_en:
The billing method. Valid values:
PrePaid: subscription.
PostPaid: pay-as-you-go
ChargeType.description_zh:
付费类型，返回值：
PrePaid：预付费，即包年包月。
PostPaid：后付费，即按量付费

CloudType.description_en: This parameter is returned only for CloudBox instances
CloudType.description_zh: 仅云盒实例显示该参数

Config.description_en:
The parameter settings of the instance. The value is in JSON format. For details, see [Metric description]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/43885.html）.
To query the audit log configuration, call the [DescribeAuditLogConfig]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473830.html） operation
Config.description_zh:
实例的参数配置信息，格式为JSON，详情请参见[参数说明]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/43885.html），
查看审计日志配置可使用[DescribeAuditLogConfig]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473830.html）接口

ConnectionDomain.description_en: The internal endpoint of the instance

Connections.description_en: The maximum number of connections supported by the instance

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the instance was created. The time follows the format of yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC)

EndTime.description_en: The time when the subscription instance expires. The time follows the format of yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC)
EndTime.description_zh: 预付费实例到期时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

Engine.description_en: The database engine type. The return value is fixed as Redis
Engine.description_zh: 数据库类型，返回值固定为Redis

EngineVersion.description_en: The Redis-compatible engine version of the instance. Valid values: 2.8, 4.0, 5.0, 6.0, and 7.0
EngineVersion.description_zh: 实例兼容Redis的版本，返回值：2.8、4.0、5.0、6.0或7.0

GlobalInstanceId.description_en:
The instance ID of the distributed instance to which the instance belongs.
This parameter is returned only when the instance is a child instance of a distributed instance
GlobalInstanceId.description_zh:
所属的分布式实例ID。
当Redis实例为分布式实例中的子实例时，才会返回本参数

HasRenewChangeOrder.description_en:
Indicates whether the instance has a pending renewal with Upgrade/Downgrade order that has not taken effect. Valid values:
true: Yes.
false: No
HasRenewChangeOrder.description_zh:
是否有未生效的续费变配订单，返回值：
true：是。
false：否

InstanceClass.description_en: The instance type. For more information, see [Instance types]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/107984.html）
InstanceClass.description_zh: 实例规格，请参见[实例规格表]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/107984.html）

InstanceReleaseProtection.description_en:
Indicates whether release protection is enabled for the instance. Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
InstanceReleaseProtection.description_zh:
是否开启了实例释放保护，返回值：
true：已开启。
false：未开启

InstanceStatus.description_en:
The instance status. Valid values:
Normal: Normal.
Creating: being created.
Changing: being modified.
Inactive: disabled.
Flushing: being flushed.
Released: released.
Transforming: being transformed.
Migrating: being migrated.
BackupRecovering: being restored from a backup.
MinorVersionUpgrading: undergoing a minor engine version update.
NetworkModifying: undergoing a network change.
SSLModifying: undergoing an SSL change.
MajorVersionUpgrading: undergoing a major engine version upgrade. The instance can be accessed normally.

For more information about instance statuses, see [Instance statuses and impacts]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200740.html）
InstanceStatus.description_zh:
实例状态，返回值：
Normal：正常。
Creating：创建中。
Changing：修改中。
Inactive：被禁用。
Flushing：清除中。
Released：已释放。
Transforming：转换中。
Migrating：迁移中。
BackupRecovering：备份恢复中。
MinorVersionUpgrading：小版本升级中。
NetworkModifying：网络变更中。
SSLModifying：SSL变更中。
MajorVersionUpgrading：大版本升级中，可正常访问。

更多实例状态及详细信息，请参见[实例状态与影响]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200740.html）

InstanceType.description_en:
The instance type. Valid values: Tair Redis
Classic Tair memory-optimized instances also return the Redis instance type. Memcache
InstanceType.description_zh:
实例类型，返回值： Tair Redis
其中经典版Tair内存型也会返回Redis实例类型。 Memcache

IsOrderCompleted.description_en:
Indicates whether the instance order is completed. This parameter is used to determine whether a specification change order has reached a final state. Valid values:
true: The specification change is completed, or no specification change has been performed.
false: A specification change is in progress
IsOrderCompleted.description_zh:
实例订单是否完成，用于判断变配订单是否到达终态，返回值：
true：变配已完成，或进行未变配。
false：变配中

IsRds.description_en:
Indicates whether the instance is managed by ApsaraDB RDS. Valid values:
true: Yes.
false: No
IsRds.description_zh:
是否属RDS管控，返回值：
true：是。
false：否

IsSupportTDE.description_en:
Indicates whether the instance supports Transparent Data Encryption (TDE). Valid values:
true: Supported. Only classic memory-optimized instances support this feature.
false: Not supported
IsSupportTDE.description_zh:
实例是否支持开启透明数据加密TDE（Transparent Data Encryption）功能，返回值：
true：支持，仅经典版内存型实例支持。
false：不支持

MaintainEndTime.description_en: The end time of the O&M window. The time follows the format of HH:mmZ (UTC)
MaintainEndTime.description_zh: 可运维结束时间，格式为HH:mmZ（UTC时间）

MaintainStartTime.description_en: The start time of the O&M window. The time follows the format of HH:mmZ (UTC)
MaintainStartTime.description_zh: 可运维开始时间，格式为HH:mmZ（UTC时间）

NetworkType.description_en:
The network type. Valid values:
CLASSIC: classic network.
VPC: VPC
NetworkType.description_zh:
网络类型，返回值：
CLASSIC：经典网络。
VPC：专有网络

NodeType.description_en:
The node type. Valid values:
double: dual-replica.
single: single-replica.
readone: read/write splitting instance with classic architecture and one read-only node.
readthree: read/write splitting instance with classic architecture and three read-only nodes
NodeType.description_zh:
节点类型，返回值：
double：双副本。
single：单副本。
readone：经典架构读写分离实例，一个只读节点。
readthree：经典架构读写分离实例，三个只读节点

PackageType.description_en:
The plan type. Valid values:
standard: standard plan.
customized: custom plan. This plan type is no longer available
PackageType.description_zh:
套餐类型，返回值：
standard：标准套餐。
customized：定制套餐，已下线

Port.description_en: The service port of the instance

PrivateIp.description_en:
The private IP address of the VPC.
This parameter is not returned if the network type of the instance is classic network
PrivateIp.description_zh:
专有网络IP地址。
实例的网络类型为经典网络时，不会返回本参数

QPS.description_en: The theoretical maximum queries per second (QPS)

ReadOnlyCount.description_en:
The number of read-only nodes in the primary zone.
The ReadOnlyCount and SlaveReadOnlyCount parameters are applicable only to cloud-native instances with read/write splitting enabled. If the instance uses the cluster architecture, these parameters indicate the number of read-only nodes in the primary and secondary zones for a single shard
ReadOnlyCount.description_zh:
主可用区的只读节点数（个）。
ReadOnlyCount与SlaveReadOnlyCount参数仅适用于云原生版、开启读写分离的实例。如果实例为集群架构，则上述参数分别表示单分片的（主、备可用区）只读节点数量

RealInstanceClass.description_en:
The actual shard specification of a cloud-native cluster instance. The InstanceClass parameter indicates the virtual specification.
To query the price of this specification, specify the instance type returned by this parameter in the [DescribePrice]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473807.html） operation
RealInstanceClass.description_zh:
当实例为云原生版集群实例时，本参数为云原生版集群实例的实际分片规格，InstanceClass参数为虚拟规格。
如需查询该规格的实例费用，可在[DescribePrice]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473807.html）接口中指定本参数返回的实例规格进行查询

ReplicaCount.description_en:
The number of replica nodes in the primary zone.
The ReplicaCount and SlaveReplicaCount parameters are applicable only to cloud-native instances. If the instance uses the cluster architecture, these parameters indicate the number of replica nodes in the primary and secondary zones for a single shard
ReplicaCount.description_zh:
主可用区的备节点数（个）。
ReplicaCount与SlaveReplicaCount参数仅适用于云原生版实例。如果实例为集群架构，则上述参数分别表示单分片的（主、备可用区）备节点数

ReplicationMode.description_en:
The replication architecture. Valid values:
master-slave: primary/secondary architecture of the Standard Edition.
cluster: cluster architecture, including the read/write splitting edition and the Cluster Edition.
db: cloud-native shard cluster architecture
ReplicationMode.description_zh:
副本架构，返回值：
master-slave：标准版的主备架构。
cluster：集群架构，包含读写分离版或集群版。
db：云原生分片集群架构

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs

SecondaryZoneId.description_en:
The secondary zone ID.
This parameter is not returned if the instance does not have a secondary zone ID
SecondaryZoneId.description_zh:
备可用区ID。
实例没有备可用区ID时，不返回本参数

ShardCount.description_en:
The number of shards. This parameter is applicable only to Chinese site (aliyun.com).

<props="china">This parameter is returned only when the instance is a cloud-native instance of the [Cluster Edition]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/52228.html）.</props>
ShardCount.description_zh:
分片数，本参数仅适用于中国站。

<props="china">当实例为[集群架构]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/52228.html）的云原生版实例时，才会返回本参数。</props>

SlaveReadOnlyCount.description_en: The number of read-only nodes in the secondary zone. This parameter is returned only when read/write splitting is enabled in a multi-zone deployment
SlaveReadOnlyCount.description_zh: 备可用区的只读节点数，该参数仅在多可用区中开启读写分离后才会返回

SlaveReplicaCount.description_en: The number of replica nodes in the secondary zone
SlaveReplicaCount.description_zh: 备可用区的备节点数（个）

Storage.description_en: The storage space of the Tair ESSD cloud disk-based instance
Storage.description_zh: Tair ESSD磁盘型的存储空间

VpcAuthMode.description_en:
The VPC authentication mode. Valid values:
Open: Password authentication is required.
Close: Password authentication is disabled, which means the [password-free access]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/85168.html） feature is enabled
VpcAuthMode.description_zh:
VPC认证模式，返回值：
Open：需要密码认证。
Close：关闭密码认证，即开启了[VPC免密功能]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/85168.html）

VpcId.description_en: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC)

ZoneType.description_en:
The active zone type. Valid values:
singlezone: single zone.
doublezone: Dual-zone deployment
ZoneType.description_zh:
可用区类型，返回值：
singlezone：同城单可用区。
doublezone：同城双可用区
